transport.authentication: public project token in Authorization Bearer header
transport.records: operational_log local observations; no product event mirror

dashboard_text.title: Operational Logs
dashboard_text.markdown: Operational logs live in [native PostHog Logs](https://eu.posthog.com/project/295060/logs), separate from product events. Filter services pitchcrew-runtime, pitchcrew-http or pitchcrew-daemon. Fixed bodies distinguish failed, cancelled and recovered runs. HTTP failures reflect Pitchcrew's existing 400 error handler and include expected invalid requests; they are not a server 5xx rate. Delivery requires an open renderer, enabled analytics and diagnostics, production config and the initialized SDK anonymous ID. Empty logs never establish healthy behavior.

deployment_steps: Install installOperationalLogs with the initialized SDK getDistinctId accessor in the mounted shell.
Route operational_log observations to the native transport; never analytics.captureDiagnostic.
After real opted-in traffic arrives, verify services and bodies using native Logs read tools.
Create saved views from the definitions using a currently available native Logs view API/schema or the UI; definitions are not guessed API payloads.
Add dashboard_text to Diagnostics Coverage; do not count operational_log as product events.
Do not enable absence alerts: closed apps, opt-out, startup timing and dropped requests create intentional gaps.
